question: In a patient diagnosed with idiopathic central diabetes insipidus we hope to find (before starting any treatment):

options.opa: High plasma osmolality, high natremia, increased urine osmolality.
options.opb: Low plasma osmolality, high natremia, increased urinary osmolality.
options.opc: High plasma osmolality, high natremia, decreased urine osmolality.
options.opd: Low plasma osmolality, low natremia, increased urinary osmolality.
